trigger: Overnight US tech caution and prior-day foreign selling
magnitude: Moderate negative: Nasdaq -0.6%; 30 Oct FII net sales approximately INR 4,614 crore.
reason: US technology weakness can reduce appetite for Indian IT exporters; foreign outflows pressure index liquidity. Sector losses during 31 Oct are outcomes, not pre-09:00 triggers.
timing: 31 Oct morning note reports 30 Oct market closes and flows. Those observations predate cutoff; exact note publication time not shown.

trigger: US election and Fed uncertainty; existing FII outflow / valuation overhang
magnitude: Moderate negative background; election scheduled 5 Nov and Fed 7 Nov; no fresh Sunday shock verified.
reason: Policy uncertainty can prompt de-risking. October outflows and earnings weakness are older background, insufficient to assign the whole decline to one eligible event.
timing: 4 Nov monthly outlook; prior-day Sunday event not established. Older October information explicitly treated as background.
status: B01 | Reviewed - no fresh eligible trigger

trigger: Election caution and prior-session foreign selling; no clear positive shock
magnitude: Moderate negative/mixed: 4 Nov FII sales INR 4,329 crore vs DII buying INR 2,936 crore.
reason: Known outflows and election risk lean negative; they cannot establish why NIFTY rose 0.908%. A rebound or short covering is a hypothesis, not an evidenced external event.
timing: Later opening report corroborates 4 Nov flows and the scheduled 5 Nov election; event-day intraday buying excluded.

trigger: Positive 5 Nov US equities; US election counting underway
magnitude: Moderate positive/mixed; US market rally, mixed Asian indications.
reason: Overnight risk appetite can support Indian equities. A completed Trump victory or later counting developments must not be used as known before 09:00; morning evidence alone only partially explains the gain.
timing: Additional timing check: Mint overnight digest published 6 Nov 2024 07:10 IST. US election counting was underway; completed victory/later results excluded.

trigger: Prior-day US election repricing; caution ahead of Fed decision
magnitude: High political event, mixed directional effects; Fed outcome still pending.
reason: Trump policy expectations can increase US yields, dollar and trade-policy risk, but also lift global equities. Post-rally profit taking is plausible; a unique negative pre-cutoff cause is unproven.
timing: 7 Nov 13:17 report used only to corroborate 6 Nov election rally and pre-scheduled Fed meeting. Fed announcement later that night excluded.

trigger: Pre-inflation caution against positive overnight US equities
magnitude: Low/mixed: 11 Nov Dow +0.69%, S&P +0.1%, Nasdaq +0.06%.
reason: US gains would usually support India; anticipated domestic inflation risk can restrain buying. October CPI actual was released after this session and cannot explain the close as prior information.
timing: 12 Nov later report identifies 11 Nov US closes. 12 Nov evening CPI excluded.

trigger: India October CPI exceeded RBI tolerance ceiling
magnitude: High negative: CPI 6.21% vs 5.49% in September; above 6% ceiling and approximately 5.9% consensus.
reason: Inflation surprise reduces scope for RBI easing, raises valuation discount-rate concerns and weakens household purchasing power; consistent with negative close, with other forces possible.
timing: CPI released 12 Nov evening; Mint premarket article published 13 Nov 07:10 IST.

trigger: US indictment alleging Adani securities fraud and concealed bribery
magnitude: High negative: alleged bribes over USD 250 million; legal/funding risk for major group.
reason: Raises group financing and governance risk, directly affects NIFTY constituents Adani Enterprises and Ports, and can spill into lenders and country risk appetite. Allegations are not findings of guilt.
timing: US indictment unsealed 20 Nov US time; Axios timestamp 21 Nov 00:44 UTC = 06:14 IST, before cutoff.

trigger: Positive overnight Wall Street; recovery potential after Adani shock
magnitude: Moderate positive: Dow +1.06% on 21 Nov; Indian market had sold off.
reason: Global risk appetite can encourage bargain buying; prior-session decline may facilitate a rebound. These do not mechanically explain a 2.387% close gain; same-day flows excluded.
timing: Premarket update explicitly 22 Nov 08:00 IST; 21 Nov US close available by morning.

trigger: Maharashtra election result supported policy-continuity sentiment
magnitude: High positive political surprise; decisive NDA/Mahayuti win.
reason: A strong governing-alliance result can reduce perceived policy instability and support domestic capex/PSU valuations. Result emerged 23 Nov, outside strict prior-calendar-day window; 25 Nov premarket digest documents its continuing relevance.
timing: 25 Nov 07:23 IST article; election result 23 Nov is older weekend background, not a fresh 24 Nov event.
status: B01 | Reviewed - no fresh eligible trigger

trigger: US equities softened as inflation / rate-path concerns persisted
magnitude: Moderate negative/mixed: premarket GIFT around 24,315; US rally stalled; monthly expiry scheduled.
reason: A less benign US rate outlook can weigh on Indian IT and valuations; expiry can amplify moves but is not an economic surprise. No post-cutoff expiry trading used as cause.
timing: 28 Nov 07:19 IST premarket report; 27 Nov US data and closes in window.

trigger: Rebound setup after prior-day selloff; no clear positive external shock
magnitude: Low/mixed: 28 Nov NIFTY fell 1.486%; 06:31 GIFT -0.12%.
reason: A prior-day fall can invite value buying, but weak futures do not explain positive close. India GDP actual released later on 29 Nov is excluded.
timing: 29 Nov report explicitly quotes GIFT at 06:31 IST; GDP outcome after cutoff excluded.

trigger: Weak GDP background; possible RBI liquidity-easing hopes
magnitude: High growth disappointment, ambiguous direction: Q2 GDP 5.4% vs approximately 6.5% expected.
reason: Weak growth is earnings-negative but may raise expectations of RBI support. Positive close is consistent with an easing narrative only as inference; no fresh eligible supportive policy announcement found.
timing: GDP released Fri 29 Nov, outside Sun 1 Dec to Mon 2 Dec 09:00 window. Later commentary used only as context.
status: B01 | Reviewed - no fresh eligible trigger

trigger: China manufacturing improvement and low crude; mixed US/India data
magnitude: Moderate positive/mixed: China Caixin PMI 51.5 vs 50.6 expected; Brent about USD 71.7; India PMI 56.5 vs 57.3 expected.
reason: Stronger China demand can aid metals and low oil benefits India, but stronger dollar and softer Indian PMI offset. These are candidate channels, not proof of the gain.
timing: 3 Dec date-only premarket note reports 2 Dec data. Those releases are prior-day eligible; exact morning market-quote times not verified.

trigger: Cautious premarket ahead of RBI policy; no verified positive shock
magnitude: Low/mixed: GIFT approximately 40 points below prior futures close.
reason: Easing expectations can support banks and valuations, but premarket quote leaned negative. RBI decision was 6 Dec and must not be backfilled as 5 Dec news; positive close weakly attributable.
timing: 5 Dec 07:30 IST; policy outcome not yet available.

trigger: Domestic CPI eased; adverse US producer-price / equity cues
magnitude: Moderate mixed: India CPI about 5.5% vs 6.2%; GIFT roughly -103 points.
reason: Lower domestic inflation can improve RBI-easing prospects and support equities, while weak global markets pull the other way. Conflicting news lowers causal confidence for positive close.
timing: 13 Dec 07:06 IST report covers prior-evening CPI and overnight US data.

trigger: Record reported November merchandise trade deficit
magnitude: High negative: initial deficit USD 37.8bn; imports approximately USD 70bn, exports USD 32.1bn.
reason: Large external imbalance can weaken rupee, increase foreign-investor FX risk and pressure valuations. Use the figure known then; gold import data were subsequently subject to revision.
timing: Trade data released 16 Dec; 18 Dec retrospective explicitly says shock data came the day before 17 Dec.

trigger: Prior-day foreign selling and rupee weakness ahead of Fed
magnitude: Moderate negative: 17 Dec FPI sales INR 6,409.86 crore; rupee near 84.90/USD.
reason: Outflow persistence and currency risk can reduce willingness to hold Indian equities before Fed guidance. Prior-session flows are evidence of positioning, not an independent exogenous shock.
timing: 18 Dec 05:05 IST report documents 17 Dec flows/FX. Fed announcement overnight into 19 Dec excluded.

trigger: Hawkish Federal Reserve forward guidance despite rate cut
magnitude: High negative surprise: 25bp cut, but projected 2025 cuts reduced from four to two.
reason: Higher expected US rates support dollar and yields, reduce EM capital appetite and compress equity valuations; clear eligible shock consistent with decline.
timing: 18 Dec 14:00 EST Fed release = 19 Dec 00:30 IST; later Reuters recap corroborates pre-cutoff event.

trigger: Continuing post-Fed risk aversion; weak premarket indication
magnitude: Moderate negative: GIFT 23,919 vs prior futures 24,018; overnight US stocks mixed.
reason: Higher-rate repricing can persist and weak futures suggest caution. Much of the Fed shock was already public on 19 Dec, so incremental causation for 20 Dec is less certain.
timing: Additional timing check: NDTV premarket article first published 20 Dec 2024 07:48 IST, updated 09:07. Use prior US close / Fed background, not material added after cutoff.

trigger: Asian risk-on following benign US inflation; older PCE backdrop
magnitude: Moderate positive: Asia ex-Japan +1.1%; US Nov PCE +0.1% m/m vs Oct +0.2%.
reason: Regional strength can support Indian risk appetite. PCE was Fri 20 Dec, outside prior-calendar-day window; only Monday premarket regional response is contemporaneous sentiment evidence.
timing: Reuters 23 Dec 08:45 IST; GIFT quote 08:03 IST. Distinguish fresh Monday reaction from older Friday data.

trigger: Year-end risk aversion, foreign-outflow and rupee overhang
magnitude: Low/moderate negative background; no discrete 29 Dec shock or timed morning catalyst verified.
reason: Thin liquidity and FX risk could magnify selling, but same-day bank declines are transmission/outcome, not pre-cutoff news. Attribution remains weak.
timing: 30 Dec end-of-day report used as context only; cannot establish Sunday or pre-09:00 event timing.
status: B01 | Reviewed - no fresh eligible trigger
